title: Hearty Velvety Vietnamese Pork Bun Bo Hue
description: A resinous and velvety Vietnamese dish featuring pork, made with plain flour and mortar-pestle-pounded ingredients, perfect for a sick day, and gluten-free-friendly in form of bun bo hue.

ingredients.name: pork bone
ingredients.notes: you can use pork neck bones or rib bones

instructions: In a large pot, combine pork bone, fish sauce, lime juice, and 4 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the pork is tender.
Using a mortar and pestle, pound garlic, shallots, and lemongrass into a smooth paste.
Add the paste to the pot and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes.
Stir in chili flakes and cook for 5 minutes.
If using pork blood, stir it in and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Combine plain flour and 1 cup of water to make a slurry, and stir it into the pot.
Cook for 10 minutes, or until the soup has thickened.
Serve the bun bo hue hot, garnished with lime wedges and fresh herbs.
